newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ indexed bond yields 5.38 percent at tender.
newsitem.headline: NZ indexed bond yields 5.38 percent at tender.

text.p: The allocation yield on New Zealand government inflation-indexed February 2016 bonds at Thursday's tender was 5.38 percent, the Reserve Bank said.
The tender was for NZ$50 million of the bonds, which have a 4.50 percent coupon.
In the last tender on February 13, NZ$50 million inflation-indexed February 2016 bonds yielded 4.84 percent.
Settlement date for the latest tender is April 8.
